description: User-level fonts, icons, emoji, Quick Look thumbnail, Icon Services residual, Dock icon cache, LaunchServices residual, Font Book residual, and third-party font-manager caches under $HOME and per-user Darwin C/T trees. path_count counts distinct path templates across rules. Default clean never deletes installed user fonts under ~/Library/Fonts (report-only).
never_touch_notes: $HOME/Library/Fonts as delete-enabled (installed user fonts; report-only only)
Font manager vaults/libraries that hold the only copy of purchased fonts (Extensis vaults, Connect Fonts vault, Suitcase library DB as bulk wipe)
LaunchServices secure handler database as default clean (report-only residual)
Keychains, Mail, Messages, Documents/Desktop/Downloads, CloudStorage, Photos libraries

risk_policy.ats_fontregistry_coretext_caches: low (regenerable; fonts may briefly re-rasterize; atsutil databases -remove is OS-native)
risk_policy.icon_services_dock_iconcache: medium (icons go generic until rebuild; may need killall Dock/Finder; system store needs sudo)
risk_policy.launchservices_user_residual: report-only or medium (handler maps / quarantine; prefer report)
risk_policy.font_manager_app_caches: low for Caches/Logs; medium for Application Support activation indexes
risk_policy.adobe_livetype_sync: medium (re-sync from Adobe Fonts cloud; not local .otf library)

rules.name: ATS user font cache
rules.description: Apple Type Services per-user font cache under Library/Caches. Not font files.
rules.notes: Classic ATS user cache. Prefer atsutil for full reset. Never touch ~/Library/Fonts.

rules.name: FontRegistry user cache
rules.description: com.apple.FontRegistry user cache (Library/Caches and Darwin C residual).
rules.notes: Font registry rebuilds on next font enumeration. Sibling of $TMPDIR under /var/folders/.../C/.

rules.name: fontd and CoreText related caches
rules.description: fontd, CoreText, CTFontManager, and related Apple font pipeline caches under user Caches.
rules.notes: Paths may appear only after Font Book / font validation activity. Safe regenerable caches.

rules.name: Apple app-scoped font caches
rules.description: iWork and AMS engagement font caches (not user font files).
rules.notes: Overlaps shipped macos-user-font-caches; kept for batch completeness.

rules.name: User Fonts folder (report-only)
rules.description: Installed user fonts and disabled-fonts residual. Never default delete.
rules.notes: Report size/inventory only. OS may move fonts to Disabled after updates. User-owned assets.

rules.name: Font Book collections (report-only)
rules.description: User Font Collections metadata (not caches).
rules.notes: User-created collections; report only.

rules.name: Font Book container residual
rules.description: Font Book sandboxed container caches and support residual (not the user's font files).
rules.notes: Leave Application Support / Fonts subtrees inside container alone if they hold activation DB. Prefer cache/log leaves.

rules.name: Font Book database residual (report-only)
rules.description: Font Book container Application Support and validation residual; may hold validation DB / state.
rules.notes: Report-only: database/state residual, not a safe default wipe.

rules.name: Icon Services user residual (Darwin C)
rules.description: Per-user Icon Services cache under Darwin user cache dir (sibling of $TMPDIR).
rules.notes: Icons may briefly show generic until rebuild. User-owned residual only; not system store.

rules.name: Icon Services system store (report-only)
rules.description: System-wide iconservices.store requires elevated delete; report size only.
rules.notes: Outside $HOME; never auto-delete without explicit elevated path. Classic broken-icon fix.

rules.name: Dock icon cache residual
rules.description: Dock icon cache under Darwin user C and legacy Library/Caches locations.
rules.notes: Regenerates after Dock restart. Pair with Icon Services clear for generic Dock icons.

rules.name: LaunchServices user residual (report-only)
rules.description: Per-user LaunchServices databases and quarantine events under Preferences.
rules.notes: Handler maps and quarantine DB. Report only; rebuild via lsregister, not blind rm as default.

rules.name: Quick Look and thumbnail user caches
rules.description: Quick Look thumbnailcache, ThumbnailsAgent, and related user caches.
rules.notes: Overlaps shipped Quick Look rule; expanded residual paths for wave-2 completeness.

rules.name: Quick Look Darwin C residual
rules.description: Per-user Quick Look / thumbnail service residuals under Darwin C next to $TMPDIR.
rules.notes: Observed live on modern macOS under /var/folders/.../C/.

rules.name: User Quick Look generators (report-only)
rules.description: Third-party .qlgenerator plugins installed for the user (not caches).
rules.notes: Plugins, not regenerable cache. Report orphans after app uninstall only.

rules.name: Quick Look thumbnail extension container caches
rules.description: Caches inside Apple Quick Look thumbnail extension containers (contents only).
rules.notes: Only Caches leaves inside containers; never wipe whole extension containers.

rules.name: Emoji, Memoji, stickers, AvatarKit caches
rules.description: Emoji function row, Memoji picker, stickers, and AvatarKit regenerable caches.
rules.notes: UI/emoji raster caches. Does not delete user Memoji characters from IdentityServices stores.

rules.name: SF Symbols app caches
rules.description: SF Symbols developer app caches and support residual.
rules.notes: Developer SF Symbols app only; system symbol rendering does not live solely here.

rules.name: Microsoft Office font cache (legacy prefs)
rules.description: Legacy Office Font Cache files under Preferences/Microsoft (not user font files).
rules.notes: Classic Office for Mac font cache files; regenerable. Overlaps office pack if already shipped.

rules.name: Adobe Fonts / Typekit sync cache
rules.description: Adobe Fonts livetype sync, TypeSupport, and Adobe Fonts cache trees. Activated fonts re-sync from cloud.
rules.notes: livetype holds cloud-activated fonts (often numbered .otf under .r). Re-sync after clear. Prefer while CC apps quit.

rules.name: RightFont residual caches
rules.description: RightFont Application Support residual and caches/logs. Prefer cache leaves over full library wipe.
rules.notes: Vendor docs: delete ~/Library/Application Support/RightFont for launch issues. Prefer globs so full library not wiped when only caches intended.

rules.name: FontBase residual caches
rules.description: FontBase Electron app caches/logs and regenerable Application Support leaves.
rules.notes: IndexedDB holds activation/tags; medium risk. Font files themselves live outside (user folders).

rules.name: Suitcase Fusion / Extensis residual
rules.description: Extensis Suitcase Fusion / Connect residual caches and logs. Vaults report-only via separate rule.
rules.notes: Do not wipe Font Vault / library DB as default. Cache/log leaves only.

rules.name: Suitcase / Extensis font vault (report-only)
rules.description: Font vault/library storage for Suitcase Fusion. May be only copy of fonts.
rules.notes: Report size only. Never auto-clean font vaults.

rules.name: NexusFont residual
rules.description: NexusFont (often Wine/CrossOver or ported) caches and support residual on macOS.
rules.notes: Primarily Windows app; residual paths if run under compatibility layers. Prefer cache/log.

rules.name: SkyFonts / Monotype residual
rules.description: Monotype SkyFonts / Connect Fonts desktop residual caches and sync staging.
rules.notes: Activated SkyFonts may also land under ~/Library/Fonts/SkyFonts (covered by report-only Fonts rule). Re-sync from cloud.

rules.name: Google Fonts desktop residual
rules.description: Google Fonts desktop helper / local catalog residual under Application Support and Caches.
rules.notes: Google Fonts under ~/Library/Fonts/Google is installed font residual; treat carefully (listed with medium). Prefer report if unsure.

rules.name: Typeface app residual
rules.description: Typeface font manager caches and logs.
rules.notes: Caches only; leave Typeface library DB if present under Application Support root.

rules.name: FontExplorer X residual
rules.description: Linotype FontExplorer X caches and logs (legacy managers still seen).
rules.notes: Legacy. Avoid wiping font sets database as default; prefer Caches/Logs.

rules.name: Wordmark / other font browser residual
rules.description: Wordmark and similar font browser app caches.

rules.name: Preference pane and systemsettings icon menus caches
rules.description: User preference pane and System Settings menu icon caches.
rules.notes: Small icon/menu caches; rebuild on next System Settings open.
